correctness.rationale: The all-q bounds follow from Wu's verified q=2 Walsh-Hadamard estimates by sequence-norm interpolation and the inequality sum u_i^q <= alpha^(q-2) sum u_i^2. The compact c0 construction is a block-diagonal normalization whose Gaussian and (q,1)-summing bounds add in q-power, while single-block tests force infinite Rademacher cotype.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Wu's current v1 states only q=2. Targeted exact and synonymous searches found no every-finite-q Walsh-Hadamard separation or compact operator from a closed subspace of c0 into c0 with finite Gaussian cotype q and finite (q,1)-summing norm but infinite Rademacher cotype q. Older operator-ideal literature remains a residual bibliographic risk.

value.rationale: The result strengthens a single-exponent quantitative counterexample to failure for every fixed finite exponent and converts it into a compact qualitative ideal separation in separable subspaces of c0, adjacent to the classical positive Banach-lattice and C(K) theory.
